Phase 76 impl @ 8e2b2fc (branch phase-76-field-fixes); plan docs/phases/field-fixes.md.

What changed:
- tagteam/roadmap.py: _SLUG_SUFFIX_RE + _heading_identity(title) -> (name, slug), used by parse_roadmap and validate_identities. _resolve_ref is unchanged (it matches p.slug).
- tagteam/lead_chat.py: _state_line shows 'turn —' for an empty turn and 'status <s> (<result>)' when a result is set.
- tagteam/iterm.py: _session_path(sid) returns iTerm2's session.path ("" for missing value or on error). _wait_for_tab_dirs(roles, abs_dir) polls; a tab in the wrong directory at the deadline gets one re-sent cd and a second deadline; a tab still wrong after that prints its role, path and last lines and makes create_session return False before any launch; a path that is never readable gets a note and does not block. Directories are compared by realpath. Launch lines are 'cd <shlex.quote(dir)> && <cmd>' for lead, reviewer and watcher.
- CLAUDE.md: notes for both rules.

Two deviations from the plan, both recorded in the phase doc:
1. A bare (slug) must contain a hyphen; a backticked one may be a single word. Reason: the existing test TestDependencyProblemLines (bugalizer's real roadmap) has 'Private repo access (proposed)', which the plan's rule would have turned into slug 'proposed'. The blast radius is unchanged: Liminal's 21 suffixes are all hyphenated, and perfalyzer's single-word slug 'reports' is backticked.
2. Observed live: a new iTerm2 tab reports session.path as 'missing value' until its shell starts, so empty means 'not known yet' and is polled until the deadline. The path is reported unresolved (/tmp, not /private/tmp), hence realpath.

How it was verified:
- Focused tests: test_roadmap.py + test_roadmap_board.py 161 passed; test_iterm.py 43 passed (fake I/O, virtual clock: arrives, heals after one re-sent cd, stays wrong -> False and nothing launched, unreadable -> note, symlinked spelling, create_session blocks launch, missing value); test_lead_chat.py -k StateLine 3 passed.
- Criterion 3, read-only, with the real parser, old vs new identity over the 42 registry roadmaps that exist: Liminal 21 slugs change, perfalyzer 6; validate_identities and validate_graph are clean on both; neither state.phase is a changed slug (Liminal single-phase on loom-glimpses; perfalyzer has no state). The 9 parse errors are seeded [Name] roadmaps, as before.
- Criterion 6, live on the arbiter's Mac via the editable uv-tool CLI on this branch: 'tagteam session start --backend iterm2' in a scratch project (pre-seeded so it skipped setup and registration) with stand-in agent commands (printf prompt; pwd; cat). All three tabs reported session.path = the project; every launch line began with 'cd <dir> &&'; pwd in lead and reviewer printed the project. Session killed; ~/.tagteam/projects.json byte-identical to before; the scratch watcher exited a few seconds after the tabs closed. The oh-my-zsh race itself was not reproduced; the fake-I/O tests cover it.
- Full suite: the gate's run on this submission.

GATE: PASS | scope 7 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (2690 passed, 5 skipped, 8m38s)
